interpretation.ifTimingExceedsPlacebo: Successful CItemXP impacts occur unusually soon after same-player weapon discharge compared with shifted times from the same player and replay. This supports using discharge timing as a source-shot assignment signal, but does not itself prove which specific shot produced the hit.
interpretation.ifTimingDoesNotExceedPlacebo: A recent same-player shot is too common during ordinary firing to identify source shots reliably by nearest-preceding timing alone. Weapon-resource mechanics or a stronger physical assignment model is required.
interpretation.precedingVsFollowing: Preceding-versus-following comparisons are descriptive because sustained automatic fire can continue through and after the soul impact.
interpretation.placeboMeaning: Shifted controls preserve player identity, hero, replay, and the player-specific firing stream while removing the exact soul-impact time relationship.
interpretation.guardrail: No value produced here is a canonical projectile velocity or exact shot-to-hit attribution.
